newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daiwa says 32 jobs to be cut in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa says 32 jobs to be cut in Germany.

text.p: The German subsidiary of Japan's Daiwa Bank said on Friday that 32 jobs will be affected by the bank's decision to close the Frankfurt office, a bank spokesman in Frankfurt said.
The bank, which offers comprehensive services including currency, bond and securities trading, will close its operations in March 1997, the spokesman said.
The spokesman said it was not yet decided where accounts and operations from the Frankfurt office will be moved to.
Daiwa said earlier on Friday that it was closing the wholly-owned German subsidiary as part of an ongoing review of its overseas operations.
Last November, the bank said it would keep the German unit open despite the closure of offices in several countries and the enforced shutdown of its U.S. operations.
